notes_for_editor: Single source. The National Historic Lookout Register entry (CAN 13, QC 3, registered 2022-12-25) is the only source found for this tower after two searches. The 1930s date is the register's belief, not a documented date, and the register says the abandonment date is unknown. The story is short on purpose. No access, staffing, fire or rental information was found, so none is stated. A Quebec toponymy fiche for Mont Gaudet (Saint-Donat) was fetched, but its cached text held no description, so it is not cited and the Saint-Donat location is unverified. The expansion file (data/raw/expansion/qc-atl_candidates.json) says the CGNDB point sits 25 m from the register point in Saint-Donat, Matawinie; that is not confirmed by a cited source here. Two Quebec records that came up in search are different structures and were not used: a 1944 tower in Pontiac (RPCQ 173551) and a village fire tower on avenue du Mont-Comi in Saint-Donat (1952 to 1980). The register's January 2022 photo, credited to Christopher Shorkey, was not downloaded or added to photos. Worth a human look: whether a Quebec ministry or SOPFEU source exists for this tower.
